# Support

## Questions and help

Start with the [README](../README.md). It covers installation, configuration, prefixes, autostart, the system tray, and debugging.

For questions, setup help, and ideas you want to talk through, use [Discussions](https://github.com/tapiaw38/edwin/discussions).

## Bugs and feature requests

Open an [issue](https://github.com/tapiaw38/edwin/issues/new/choose). Pick the bug report form for something broken, or the feature request form for something missing. The forms ask for your distribution, compositor, and version — please fill them in, since Edwin behaves differently across Wayland compositors.

## Security

Do not report security problems in public. Follow [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).

## Contributing

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
